description: Look up any game, find what to play next, and browse the Steam store from one CLI - RAWG search and ratings, remake-aware title resolution, and IsThereAnyDeal price history.

novel_features.name: Steam Store Search
novel_features.description: Plural keyless search of the Steam store across games, demos, DLC, soundtracks, software, video, mods, and hardware, with the store tags, price, and release date on every row.

novel_features.name: Steam Catalog Browse
novel_features.description: Paginated Steam catalog browse filtered by app type, free-only, store tag, and coming-soon/released, localised with --country - so "every free demo in my region" is one command.

novel_features.name: Similar Games
novel_features.description: Games like <title>: the seed's own studio first, then its defining gameplay tag (roguelite, metroidvania) found by tag-neighborhood co-occurrence, then a confidence-floored genre join. Every row carries its tier and a reason.

novel_features.name: Ratings Card
novel_features.description: One card per game: RAWG community score, Metacritic, and a keyless Steam review score with the current store price, resolving the Steam appid from RAWG so remakes never collide.

novel_features.name: Retention Verdict
novel_features.description: Community completion and drop verdict for one game from RAWG added_by_status counts (needs RAWG_API_KEY).

novel_features.name: Franchise Order
novel_features.description: Franchise play order from the RAWG game-series endpoint, so a series is played in sequence rather than by release-year guesswork.

novel_features.name: Price History
novel_features.description: All-time, 1-year, and 3-month lows with a dated change log and a buy-now verdict, localised to a --country currency (needs ITAD_API_KEY).

novel_features.name: Storefront Prices
novel_features.description: Current prices across every storefront, cheapest first, with a --deals-only filter, localised to a --country currency (needs ITAD_API_KEY).
